title: Batching playbook: workload profiling, heuristic synthesis, and safe rollout automation
creator: Sofia Patel
description: Create a reproducible, production-safe 'batching playbook' and automation for synthesizing continuous batching parameters from workload profiles. The goal is to recommend per-route batching and caching parameters that reduce cost-per-token while meeting latency SLOs and providing automatic safe apply/rollback during rollout. Work includes a lightweight profiler, heuristic synthesis engine, risk scoring, and an automated canary/apply pipeline integrated with Console rollouts and runtime metrics.
comments: 2025-02-12 - Sofia Patel: Kickoff meeting notes. Agreed scope: profiler + heuristic synthesizer + safe apply pipeline. MVP constrained to text-generation routes and a single dedicated runtime pool. Links to kickoff slides in attachments.

2025-02-18 - Liam Chen: Research spike complete. Two profiler options validated: 1) passive telemetry sampler (low overhead), 2) active micro-prober that injects synthetic sequences (higher fidelity). Initial numbers: passive estimates batching headroom within 10% of prober for 75% of routes.

2025-02-20 - Priya Kapoor (PM) review: Prioritize passive profiler for MVP to avoid runtime overhead and customer risk. PM asks for clear rollback triggers and funnel for manual approval. Added to acceptance criteria.

2025-02-25 - Engineering review: Prototype synthesizer produced heuristics mapping 95th latency headroom to target max_batch_size, target_concurrency, and prefix_cache_ttl. Observed trade-off: increasing max_batch_size beyond 64 improved cost for short sequences but caused 95th-tail regressions on high-percentile routes. Suggest conservative defaults plus aggressive canary rules.
2025-02-28 - Design feedback (Ava Martinez): UX should surface estimated cost savings, SLO risk score, and a replay button for suggested config. Design mock linked in attachments.
2025-03-01 - Security (Evelyn Zhao): No KMS changes required. Ensure profiler data excludes PII; added sanitizer step to pipeline.

2025-03-03 - Liam Chen: Implemented canary runner and rollback hooks. Canary will apply to 1% traffic on dedicated pools and monitor cost delta, 95th latency, error rate for 10 minutes prior/after. Auto-rollback conditions drafted below.
2025-03-03 - Notes: Next spike - integrate with Console rollout API for manual override and to surface telemetry per-ticket.
acceptance_criteria: Passive profiler collects representative sequence length and arrival patterns for 95% of routes with <1% overhead on p50 latency
Heuristic synthesizer outputs a single suggested config (max_batch_size, concurrency, prefix_cache_ttl) and a risk score per route
Canary pipeline can apply suggestions to a subset of traffic (configurable min 1%) and automatically rollback on rule violations
Console surfaces suggestion, estimated cost delta, and estimated SLO impact for each route
End-to-end e2e tests and playbook runbook documented in Confluence
decisions: MVP will use passive telemetry profiler instead of active probing to minimize production risk
Heuristics will prioritize latency SLO preservation over maximum cost savings (safety-first defaults)
Canary window default set to 10 minutes; thresholds: +5% cost improvement target, <2% relative increase in 95th latency, <0.1% error rate increase
Suggest storing suggested configs as immutable rollout artifacts to enable deterministic rollback
Sanitize and aggregate telemetry to remove any PII before sending to heuristics engine
